# Source Sans 3

The upright variable font from [adobe-fonts/source-sans](https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-sans),
release `3.052R` (commit `ed1808970eb3c7301c9a523bee26473ba0bb62fa`), file
`VF/SourceSans3VF-Upright.ttf`, unmodified. `LICENSE.md` is upstream's.

Embedded by `drip-gui` as its proportional font.
